blocks.text:
Inherited from Proto-Slavic *dati, from Proto-Balto-Slavic *dṓˀtei, from Proto-Indo-European *dédeh₃ti (“to give”), whence English donate, date and data (via Latin and Romance).

Also cognate with Sanskrit ददाति, Sanskrit दान, Persian دادن and Latin dō.
